messages:
Priya: Quick heads-up — I'm planning the staged rollout for runtime v2.3 at ~10:15 PT. Need a short smoke + sampling profiling sweep 10:00–10:30. Looking for p95/p99 across small/med/long seqs. Can someone grab sampling traces and kick PerfBot runs? Thanks
Alex: I'm available. I'll run the smoke harness against the staged pool at 10:00. Which model variants to hit?
Priya: @Alex target these: gpt-small-quant, gpt-medium-8bit, and gpt-medium-4bit-fp16 (fallback). Seq lens: 64, 512, 2048. 50 reps per combo. Tag runs with run_id=staged-v2.3-priya.
Jamal: I'll collect sampling traces and nvprof on one host. Share the canary box names and confirm KV cache state.
Priya: KV cache = ON. Canary boxes: runtime-canary-a1, runtime-canary-a2, runtime-canary-b1. Runbook link: /ops/runbooks/staged-v2.3. Use --warmup 200.
Alex: starting now. Command I'm using:
```
perf-run --model gpt-medium-8bit --seq 512 --reps 50 --warmup 200 --tag staged-v2.3-priya
```
Maria: I'll start PerfBot for histograms + torch metrics, sampling rate 0.2. Expect results ~20m after start.
PerfBot: scheduled perf sweep for run_id=staged-v2.3-priya; will post latency histograms and throughput by 10:25.
Jamal: grabbed sampling traces from runtime-canary-a1, uploading: s3://redwood-perf/staged-v2.3/trace-2112233344.tar.gz
Alex: noting preliminary numbers: p95 +12% on gpt-medium-4bit-fp16 for seq=2048, p99 also elevated. Collecting logs now.
Priya: Copy. Criteria: if p95 > +10% OR p99 > +15% vs baseline, we hold. Can someone generate flamegraphs for the 4bit-fp16 run?
Jamal: flamegraphs ready and uploaded -> s3://redwood-perf/staged-v2.3/flamegraphs/ (files: fp16_longseq.svg, fp16_medseq.svg)
Maria: PerfBot posted histograms: avg +4%, p95 +11% on gpt-medium-4bit-fp16; p99 shows spikes on long seq. Link: <https://perf.redwood/internal/staged-v2.3/histograms>
Priya: Decision: pause staged rollout for the 4bit-fp16 variant and continue only with gpt-medium-8bit + gpt-small-quant. @Alex prepare rollback for the 4bit-fp16 routing change. @Oncall Sam FYI.
Alex: ack. Starting rollback: removing 4bit-fp16 from routing policy and backfilling traffic to 8bit. Creating PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/7890 (wip).
PerfBot: aborting further sweeps for variant gpt-medium-4bit-fp16 due to hold flag.
Oncall Sam: noted. I'll keep an eye on alerts and autoscaler behavior while rollback runs.
Priya: Thanks everyone — keep logs and links in this thread. We'll run a kernel-level bisect and re-evaluate after fixes. :thumbsup:
Alex: adding postmortem notes to the rollout doc and linking traces.
Maria: scheduling a follow-up probe window tomorrow 09:30 PT to re-run after bisect steps.
Priya: Perfect — follow-up agenda: bisect, kernel patch candidate, re-run sampling, then small canary.
Alex: copied. Closing my real-time runs, will update PR when ready.
